Metadata/GridSpatialRepresentation/GridD.description: The Equal-Area Scalable Earth Grid (EASE-Grid 2.0) is used for gridding satellite data sets.  The EASE-Grid 2.0 is defined on the WGS84 ellipsoid to allow users to import data into standard GIS software formats such as GeoTIFF without reprojection.
